# FDG4017

> DO NOT treat static classes as a miscellaneous bucket.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.5 Static Class Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Whether a static class has a clear charter is a design judgment; not machine-checkable.

## From the book

There should be a clear charter for each class. When your description of the class involves “and” or a new sentence, you need another class.
